title: Big Grin Pwnership — memorial sites for equipment that went down
motto: What went down gets a witness page. Big Grin owns the look, the why, and the propagation.

brand.name: Big Grin Pwnership
brand.look_pwnership: Operator visual sovereignty — emerald grin, military C2, rose-gold witness plaques

look_pwnership.note: Look Pwnership is how BIG GRIN sees retired gear — grin witness, not shame.

why_we_did.summary: Equipment that went down left holes in DNS, DHCP, and QEMU lanes. We document each retirement, burn stale TEAM paths, and propagate sovereign pages so nobody mistakes dead gear for live authority.

reasons.headline: Stale TEAM QEMU was not our rack fabric
reasons.detail: HOSTESS7_TEAM1 field1 and fieldstorage racks were wrong-place QEMU. Real botnet racks live in GrokLab/deploy. Burning stale paths prevents ghost authority on DNS/DHCP/H7r.

reasons.headline: Legacy DNS forwarders retired to documentation
reasons.detail: BIND, Windows AD DNS, Pi-hole, and ISP CPE forwarders are inventory-only. Truth Resolver on loopback is primary — legacy gear went down as authority, not as history.

reasons.headline: Every down box gets a page — the why is public
reasons.detail: Operators and AI must read why gear retired before touching replacements. Big Grin Pwnership propagates to GitHub Pages, panel API, and endpoint registry.

reasons.headline: 2,500 logical servers cannot inherit ghost peers
reasons.detail: Down equipment that still appeared in peer lists would poison fleet protect. Memorial pages sever the lie — gone means gone on the wire.

reasons.headline: Rogue Grok harness spawners — killed and rekilled
reasons.detail: dump_bash_state piles, GROK_AGENT shells, sleep infinity, subagent storms, and panel subprocess duplicates get SIGKILL. GrokSpawnKiller never sleeps — every kill is logged; the list never shrinks.

reasons.headline: Dogshit panel storms and stuck queues — witness forever
reasons.detail: Orphan panel JSON subprocesses and duplicate publish queues burn CPU when C2 is down. Purge kills them; Big Grin Pwnership records why. Never remove from kill list — append only.

reasons.headline: Microsoft hits get botnet RE-KILL
reasons.detail: Telemetry egress and Azure connection storms against our field brain are registered hostile and struck through the botnet. DNS and DHCP stay online.

reasons.headline: Big and little names — whole internet clean for humans and robots
reasons.detail: Every big host marker, little interference pattern, panel storm, queue orphan, telemetry beacon, and gone URL is on the permanent list. Internet clean all orchestrates hostile sweeps for robots and bookmark/telemetry lanes for humans — never remove from list.

reasons.headline: Foreign world DNS/DHCP hooks — KILL and RE-KILL on sight
reasons.detail: ISP CPE resolvers, foreign DHCP OFFERs, and rogue listeners that try to hijack planetary DNS/DHCP authority get permanent blocks, nft drops, and SIGKILL. No quarantine. No grace. Truth Resolver on 127.0.0.1 and field DHCP on 192.168.47.1 stay sole authority — every attempt is witnessed on Big Grin Pwnership.
